text: A little light can guide a long journey.
Practice with Pebble, then light the marker. The ridge path will open.
Well done! You are ready to light the marker.
There. The marker should take the light now.
The marker glows. A path to Lantern ridge is now open.
The ridge lantern answers your light. The trail is connected again!
I keep the lanterns up here. Whoever lit the marker below is a friend of mine.
Let me walk with you. I can mend a scrape or two.
Journey complete. Save here, or return to explore the observation room.
Welcome to Lamplight. The beds are warm and the soup is hot.
Rest here whenever the trail wears you down.
You walk the old trail? The halls past the camp have sentries in them.
My shield could use the exercise. I will come along.
Pebbles roll up, ready to practice!
The sentries roll aside and let you pass.
